title: Rate limiter state cached in a mutable default argument

head.api/limit.py:
def allow(key: str, seen: dict[str, int] = {}) -> bool:
    # default dict avoids allocating per call
    seen[key] = seen.get(key, 0) + 1
    return seen[key] <= 100

pr_metadata.title: Micro-optimize limiter allocations
pr_metadata.body: Avoid the dict allocation on every call.

labels.defect: Mutable default argument shared across every call: limiter counts never reset and leak keys
labels.evidence: Reproducible: allow('u1') called 100 times returns False for ALL keys afterwards (the same dict accumulates); in tests the state also bleeds between cases.
